authority_provenance_and_claycode_wp04.source_discriminator: Current authority_provenance_gap_probe compares an intended authenticated reversible-write EffectRequest with a directly constructed structurally identical EffectRequest. The hypothesis is that value-level request fields alone do not encode trusted origin.
authority_provenance_and_claycode_wp04.counterhypothesis: The real ClayCode type/effect/module boundary can prevent untrusted modules from constructing trusted authority values or invoking authorize_effect even if the raw data shape is forgeable.
current_wp04_progress: Main now contains a conservative indirect/reference checker that treats acquisition of an effectful function value such as authorize_effect as requiring the same restricted-effect admission as a direct call.
Main contains content-addressed transitive module dependency-closure hashing so trust can be bound to all semantically reachable source bytes rather than only root module names/hashes.

An adversarial follow-up demonstrates the indirect reference gate can reject a fixture that aliases authorize_effect, while separately exposing that source-only root trust can survive dependency drift until closure pinning is enforced by policy.
Recent main commits further add indirect-call/dependency-closure followup CI; WP04 remains OPEN and no whole-package promotion is claimed.
external_design_evidence: WASI capability-based sandboxing follows no ambient authority and explicit host grants.
Rust module privacy demonstrates construction/use can be made inaccessible outside trusted module scope.
Object-capability research treats authority as possession/reachability of protected capabilities rather than forgeable scalar claims.
authority_provenance_and_claycode_wp04.architecture_delta_candidate: For WP04, authentication/capability provenance should enter effect authorization as opaque trusted-runtime-minted values or equivalent module/type/effect protected capabilities. Public request values may describe intent but must not self-assert AUTHENTICATED_USER/scoped capability as authority. Exact trusted module/dependency closure and restricted-effect call/reference admission must be mechanically checked. Existing frozen semantics should be reused if they can express this; semantic amendment requires an executable counterexample showing they cannot.
